Name: Un-mechanical Bosses
Author: TdT
Description:
What if the Mechanical Bosses... were NOT mechanical?
This recource pack aims to make that a reality by trying to capture terraria's original style while still bringing something new to the table.

This pack cosists of:

	-'Localization chages'

	-'*NEW* Bestiary entries'

	-'Achievement resprites'

	-'changed names for two bosses:
		>Prime Skeletron. (The vengfull spirit was resurected, looking for revenge)
		>The Hallowed serpent. (Tissue from the evil boss that has regrown itself with the essence you freed)

	-'Mechdusa?'

Currently supports only english localization.
